name: xchain-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server for the XChain Platform: read chain/token/balance data on BTC, LTC and DOGE (mainnet/testnet/regtest), and optionally submit policy-gated actions, backed by the XChain SDK.
comment:homepage: The npm package page links wherever this points, and it points at the platform site.
comment:files: Publish allowlist: the server is two files. README/LICENSE/package.json ship automatically.
